description: This header file defines utility functions for converting between string representations and enum types (SourceType, PlayMode, AudioType), as well as a function to extract file protocol from URLs. It also includes licensing information and include guards.

methods.name: sourceTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a SourceType enum value.

methods.name: sourceTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a SourceType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: playModeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a PlayMode enum value.

methods.name: playModeToString
methods.description: Converts a PlayMode enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: audioTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to an AudioType enum value.

methods.name: audioTypeToString
methods.description: Converts an AudioType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: extractFileProtocol
methods.description: Checks if a URL has a 'file://' protocol and removes it, returning true if found.
